questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Trading Card Live Auction', video, 'Orders (2)', 'Shop items' and 'Chat & activities' read as a live console.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The current lot 'SB02 Quickfire · NT$25 · 12 bids' is central, but no control stands out beyond a green '+' at the bottom of Shop items.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Mute' is clear; 'Antisniping' and 'Auction tiers' don't say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Antisniping', 'Auction tiers' and the clipped 'Ready to …' stat are unexplained.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The seller acts only on lots and chat they set up.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Orders show 'Payment status: Unpaid' and full 'Order ID' UUIDs during the show.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Order IDs and payment status are fulfilment detail sitting in the live-hosting console.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Dense multi-line order rows add reading, though tables are scannable.
